question: Should `HEARTBEAT.md` remain the canonical public workspace file, or should OpenClaw transition to a proactive filename with an explicit compatibility plan?
rationale: The filename is exposed across persisted workspaces, runtime behavior, prompts, documentation, and Gateway file APIs, so implementation depends on intentional naming and upgrade policy.

options.title: Keep HEARTBEAT.md
options.body: Retain the existing public contract and improve newcomer-facing explanation in onboarding and documentation instead.

options.title: Transition with migration
options.body: Adopt a precisely cased proactive filename and provide a doctor-owned migration or documented compatibility window for existing workspaces and clients.

options.title: Add permanent alias
options.body: Support both names indefinitely, accepting duplicate-contract and source-of-truth complexity.

recommendation.title: Keep HEARTBEAT.md
recommendation.body: Retain the existing public contract and improve newcomer-facing explanation in onboarding and documentation instead.
